slots.title: Here's what's crashing gold and likely weighing on bitcoin too
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Gold fell to its lowest level since September 2025 on Friday, and the same catalyst driving its decline is likely also weighing on bitcoin.

slots.title: This Bitcoin miner sold 267 BTC to clear $22 million debt. It still may not survive
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: PowerCompute had its lender sell 267 pledged bitcoin in September, wiping out most of its debt, and ended the month with about $650,000 in cash and a going-concern warning.

slots.title: Anthropic’s $81B IPO draws half the net retail buying of SpaceX’s
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: Retail investors traded $772 million in Anthropic shares on Thursday, the most Vanda Research has recorded for a market debut since 2012.

slots.title: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac

slots.summary: The iPhone maker appears to be building agents that can compete with the likes of Meta Muse, Instinct, Claude, and OpenAI Dots.

slots.title: Anthropic shares may fall 5% at Friday’s open, crypto futures suggest
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: About $1.7 billion traded through a Hyperliquid contract on the AI company’s shares in 24 hours, and the biggest position heading into Friday’s Nasdaq open is a $30 million short.

slots.title: Big money bought a net $4 billion of bitcoin funds in Q3, ending 9 months of selling
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Wall Street piled into Bitcoin funds in the third quarter, ending a three-quarter selling streak, according to Galaxy Research. But the buying has given way to renewed selling this quarter.
